title: Theorem 4: arbitrary finite-field three-term-relation-free bound 3m_((q-1)n/3)
statement_scope: Whole Theorem th:main, source lines 218-226. Let F_q be a finite field and n a positive integer. Let alpha, beta, gamma be elements of F_q with alpha + beta + gamma = 0 and gamma != 0, and let A be a subset of F_q^n such that alpha a_1 + beta a_2 + gamma a_3 = 0 has no solutions (a_1,a_2,a_3) in A^3 apart from those with a_1=a_2=a_3. Let m_d be the number of monomials in x_1,...,x_n with total degree at most d and each variable degree at most q-1. Then |A| <= 3 m_{(q-1)n/3}. All hypotheses and the exact bound are retained; this is not a q=3-only specialization.

standard_prerequisites: Finite field F_q and the F_q-vector space of functions from F_q^n to F_q.

Elementary complement bijection for q-power-free monomials: monomials of degree greater than d correspond to monomials of degree less than (q-1)n - d.
